Body.Content:
What and why

A new streaming switchboard in Microsoft Teams will allow event producers to more easily manage and send NDI® sources to production software during Teams meetings and events. Event producers can individually select and stream up to eight NDI sources directly from a Teams meeting or event.

Rollout schedule

  • General Availability (Worldwide): Beginning in early November 2026 and expected to complete by mid-November 2026

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Event producers who use NDI streaming in Microsoft Teams meetings and events

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Teams

What will happen

  • Event producers will be able to individually select and stream up to eight NDI sources from a Teams meeting or event.
  • To access the feature during a meeting or event, select More actions, then Streaming > Streaming switchboard.
  • Admins must enable NDI streaming before users can use the feature.
  • Users must turn on production capabilities in Teams before using NDI broadcast production. 

Action required and recommendations

To prepare:

  • Enable AllowNDIStreaming for the appropriate users through the CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet.
  • Instruct affected users to turn on production capabilities in Teams.

Learn more

  • Allow broadcast production in Teams meetings with NDI and SDI hardware - Microsoft Teams | Microsoft Learn

Compliance considerations

QuestionAnswer
Does the change add any integration to third-party software products, and if so, what?Yes. NDI® enables Microsoft Teams meeting content to be sent to production software.
Does the change include an admin control, and can it be controlled through Entra ID group membership?Yes. Admins can control NDI® streaming through the AllowNDIStreaming setting in CsTeamsMeetingPolicy. The provided source does not specify whether the control can be managed through Entra ID group membership.
Does the change allow a user to enable and disable the feature themselves?Yes. After an admin enables NDI streaming, users must turn on production capabilities in Teams.

Details.Name: Summary
Details.Value: Microsoft Teams will introduce a streaming switchboard allowing event producers to select and stream up to eight NDI sources during meetings and events, starting November 2026. Admins must enable NDI streaming via policy, and users must activate production capabilities to use the feature.
